label: Quikr

discovery.auth: App ID + HMAC-SHA1 signed daily access token

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence medium). Quikr Developer Platform documents ads-by-location/category, post/edit ad and image APIs with app-id/HMAC tokens; portal looks legacy but token endpoint still responds.

reason: Quikr Developer Platform (https://developer.quikr.com/index.php/documentation, rendered 2026-09-25) documents Ads by Location/Category and ad posting, but every call carries X-Quikr-Signature-v2 = HMAC-SHA1 keyed with the daily minted token over appId+email+yyyy-MM-dd, and the token request itself is signed with HMAC-SHA1(app_secret, email+appId+yyyy-MM-dd). The runtime signs only with a credential field as key and has no yyyy-MM-dd date placeholder in token signatures, so neither step can be expressed.
